title: Presentation of “{{title}}”
intro: Choose what your audience sees, in which order, and what only you see. The slides follow your teaching: when you change the teaching, they change too.

start.text: Make slides from this teaching: its title, passages, central message, points or steps, questions and kept images, in the teaching’s order. You then keep, leave out, change or add slides.
start.noAi: Made by fixed rules on this computer. No assistant is used.

presenter.title: Presenter View
presenter.empty: This presentation has no slides to show yet.
presenter.keepAwakeOn: The screen stays on while you present.
presenter.keepAwakeUnavailable: This system does not let the app keep the screen on. If it turns off while you present, change the power settings.
presenter.keys: Keys: →, Page Down or Space for the next slide; ← or Page Up to go back; a number and Enter to go to that slide; O for the overview; B to blank the audience screen; Esc to close a panel, or twice to stop presenting.
presenter.audienceHelp: The audience sees only the slides: never your notes, manuscript or sources.
presenter.noSecondWindow: A second window cannot be opened here. Show the slides in this window instead (for a mirrored screen); Esc brings you back.
presenter.oneScreen: Only one screen is connected. Connect a projector or second screen, or show the slides in this window.
presenter.noBible: No Bible is installed to look up the passage.
presenter.escAgain: Press Esc again to stop presenting
presenter.escAgainAudience: Press Esc again to close the audience screen
presenter.elapsedWaiting: Time so far: {{time}} (starts when you move on)

templates.title: Church templates
templates.intro: Use your church’s own slide design: import it from a PowerPoint file, bring a template file from another computer, or make a simple one here. A template is only a design; it never holds sermon content.
templates.keynote: Keynote: choose File › Export To › PowerPoint, then import that file here.
templates.googleSlides: Google Slides: choose File › Download › Microsoft PowerPoint (.pptx), then import that file here.
templates.libreOffice: LibreOffice Impress: choose File › Save As and the PowerPoint (.pptx) format. OpenDocument (.odp) files cannot be read directly yet.
templates.fontsNote: Fonts are never copied with a template. If a font is missing on this computer, you are told and can choose one that is installed.
templates.removed: “{{name}}” was removed. Presentations that used it show their built-in background again.
templates.deleteConfirm: Delete this template? Presentations using it keep their slides and show their built-in background again.
templates.choosePptx: Choose a PowerPoint file with your church’s design
templates.choosePackage: Choose an Abiding Word template file
templates.name: Name of the template
templates.nameNeeded: Please give the template a name.

codes.slidesIgnored_one: The design only; the file’s {{count}} slide is not imported
codes.slidesIgnored_other: The design only; the file’s {{count}} slides are not imported
codes.embeddedFonts: The file contains fonts; they are not carried over
codes.fontMissing: A font is not installed here
codes.fontStyleMissing: A font is installed, but not in the weight or slant used
codes.fontNotEmbeddable: A font’s licence prevents it from being included in PDFs; a standard font is used instead
codes.wrapRisk: Lines may break differently because of a replaced font
codes.tiledBackground: A tiled background picture is shown stretched
codes.gradientBackground: A colour gradient becomes its first colour
codes.patternBackground: A patterned background becomes one colour
codes.effects: Shadows, glow or 3D effects are not drawn
codes.growsWithText: A box that grows with its text keeps its size (long text is reported)
codes.noWrap: Text from a box with wrapping disabled wraps here
codes.svgAsPicture: An SVG picture is shown from its PNG copy
codes.extraTextBox: An extra text box is not used
codes.imageFormat: Picture formats that cannot be shown (EMF, WMF, TIFF…)
codes.contentPlaceholder: Placeholders for tables, charts or media
codes.offPage: Items with no size or far off the slide are left out

templates.fontsHint: A font is only replaced if you choose one. Your choice is kept with the template.
templates.notEmbeddable: PDFs use a standard font because this font’s licence prevents embedding.
templates.layouts: Layout for each kind of slide
templates.layoutsHint: Suggestions are only made where the match is clear. A kind left on the built-in arrangement uses the template’s colours and fonts.

templates.overflowSummary_other: On {{count}} slides the text is too long for the template’s box. It is not made smaller automatically: shorten it, or turn on “Make long text smaller to fit” for that box in the template.

templates.overflowExport_other: {{count}} text boxes are too small for their text; check them in the file.

sample.title: Remain in the vine
sample.heading: Fruit grows from staying close
sample.text: A branch does not strain to bear fruit; it stays connected to the vine.
sample.verse: I am the vine; you are the branches. Whoever abides in me and I in him, he it is that bears much fruit, for apart from me you can do nothing.
sample.quote: Abiding is not a technique but a friendship.
sample.question: Where do you try to bear fruit on your own?
